key_point: America's Mario 2 was not a Mario game
title: America's Mario 2 was not a Mario game
caption: Super Mario Bros. 2 in the US was really a Japanese game called Doki Doki Panic. #gamefacts #didyouknow #gaming #supermariobros2 #nintendo

instagram.caption:
The Super Mario Bros. 2 most Americans grew up with started as a different game: Doki Doki Panic.

Japan's real sequel was so hard that Nintendo of America decided it would frustrate players, so they reskinned Doki Doki Panic with Mario and friends.

That swap is why Shy Guy, Birdo and pulling vegetables out of the ground became part of Mario history.

Did you know your Mario 2 was a different game?
